Third-party software bundled with the ToolReady PDF tools
(self-hosted so the editor page never loads code from another website)

1. PDF.js (pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs, wasm/, standard_fonts/)
   Copyright Mozilla Foundation and contributors.
   Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see PDFJS-LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt)
   Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
   The bundled wasm decoders and standard fonts carry their own licences
   (OpenJPEG, JBIG2, qcms, Foxit, Liberation fonts) - see the upstream
   pdfjs-dist package for the full texts.

2. pdf-lib (pdf-lib.min.js)
   Copyright (c) 2019 Andrew Dillon - MIT License
   Source: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib

3. Noto Sans Sinhala / Noto Sans Tamil (../fonts/*.woff2)
   Copyright The Noto Project Authors - SIL Open Font License 1.1
   https://openfontlicense.org  (distributed via the Fontsource project)
